notes: The gallery (azmvdnow.gov/plates, which azdot.gov/plates redirects to) is refused by WebFetch every way it was tried (https, http, from the redirect and from ADOT news links). The per-plate pages at azdot.gov/license-plates/<slug> do have plate images (alt text shows) but their image addresses never come through the fetch, so ADOT images could not be read. ADOT news releases carry only a highway banner and link no sponsors except azkidney.org and saguaros.com (4AZKids; refused). Rotary's image is the Rotary District 5495 project page on Givsum; Autism Support's is SARRC's announcement graphic (not visually confirmed to be the bare plate). Counts: ADOT said 115 plates after Maverick (30 Jun 2026) and 3 more were added 20 Aug 2026, while KTAR said 107; nothing new was found beyond pass 1. Route 66 (2016) is not new or redesigned; ADOT has its image at https://azdot.gov/sites/default/files/2026-04/Route66LicensePlate.png.
